refnamediv.refpurpose: Prepend or truncate a vector or matrix to a specified length.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: res = prepad(x, l) res = prepad(x, l, c) res = prepad(x, l, c, dim)

listitem.para: (optional) Scalar value to prepend. Default is 0.
(optional) Dimension along which to operate. Default is 2.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `prepad` function prepends the scalar value `c` to the vector or matrix `x` until it reaches the specified length `l`. If `c` is not provided, a value of 0 is used. If the length of `x` exceeds `l`, elements are removed from the beginning of `x` to match the desired length. If `x` is a matrix, the operation is performed along rows or columns based on the `dim` parameter.
